definitions.gloss: samue; simple work garment of Japanese origin
definitions.explanation: A two-piece garment (top and pants) originally worn by Zen Buddhist monks during manual labor. Now widely used as comfortable casual wear, loungewear, and work uniforms at traditional establishments.

examples.japanese: {作務衣|さむえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}て→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{庭仕事|にわしごと}→庭仕事：20710_niwashigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I do garden work wearing a samue.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{作務衣|さむえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}ていた→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
examples.english: The staff at the ryokan were wearing samue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{作務衣|さむえ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦くつろいでいる→くつろぐ：02576_kutsurogu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: My father often relaxes at home wearing a samue.

notes:
Originally the work uniform of Zen Buddhist monks. ⟦{作務|さむ}→作務：27139_samu⟧ refers to the daily manual labor (cleaning, cooking, gardening) that monks perform as part of their practice, and {衣|え} means clothing. The garment has become popular as comfortable casual wear.

USAGE:
Commonly seen worn by:
- Staff at ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧ (traditional inns) and ⟦{料亭|りょうてい}→料亭：21710_ryoutei⟧ (high-end restaurants)
- Potters, craftsmen, and artisans
- Zen monks during work
- People relaxing at home (as comfortable loungewear)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {作務衣|さむえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧: to wear a samue
- ⟦{綿|めん}→綿：03807_men⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{作務衣|さむえ}: cotton samue
- {夏用|なつよう}{作務衣|さむえ}: summer samue

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{甚平|じんべい}→甚平：10107_jinbei⟧: jinbei (similar casual wear, but short-sleeved with shorts — more summery)
- {法衣|ほうえ}: Buddhist monk's robe (formal ceremonial attire)
- ⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧: kimono (traditional formal/semi-formal wear)
